players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: Jackson (left ankle) did not practice Wednesday, Oct 14. Coach Jesse Minter called him day-to-day, and Schefter reported a realistic chance he plays Sunday vs. CLE, though Tyler Huntley could start again if Baltimore stays cautious.

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.note: Williams (hamstring, out since Week 2) practiced in full Wednesday, Oct 14. Ian Rapoport said on Oct 12 that 'all signs point' to him returning in Week 6 vs. ATL.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Mayfield is still in a splint for his dislocated right thumb. Coach Todd Bowles said this week the plan is to start Jalon Daniels vs. PIT, and Rotowire estimates Mayfield's return around Oct 25.

players.name: Michael Penix
players.note: Penix hurt his ribs in Week 5 and was reported Oct 12 to have avoided a serious injury. He practiced in full Wednesday, Oct 14, and says he expects to play vs. CHI. Tua Tagovailoa starts if he can't.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: DeMeco Ryans called Montgomery's groin injury from the Week 5 win over Tennessee 'week-to-week' (reported Oct 12). He is very likely to miss Week 6 at Jacksonville, and with Houston's bye in Week 8 he may also sit Week 7.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: With Montgomery week-to-week (groin), Marks should lead the Texans' backfield against the Jaguars in Week 6. In Week 5 he had a season-high 15 carries for 62 yards and caught all 4 targets for 23 yards (Oct 12).

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Barkley missed Week 5 with a right hamstring injury. NFL Network's Mike Garafolo reported Oct 12 that he could return in Week 6 against Carolina, and Sirianni was 'hopeful' but cautious. No practice report from this week confirms it, so his Week 6 status is unsettled.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Henderson suffered a right high-ankle sprain in the Week 5 win over the Raiders. Schefter reported Oct 13-14 that he is expected to miss multiple weeks without needing surgery, and one outlet projects he misses the Jets and Bears games.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: With Henderson out multiple weeks with a high-ankle sprain (Oct 13-14), Stevenson is expected to take a heavier load starting Sunday against the Jets. Corey Kiner is in line for a change-of-pace role.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: Judkins was seen in a walking boot after the Week 5 loss to the Jets. Monken called it an ankle 'tweak' on Oct 12, said he is day-to-day and did not rule him out against Baltimore. It is the same ankle he had surgery on as a rookie.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Monken said Oct 12 that Sampson's 21-day IR practice window could open this week after he missed 4 games with a knee injury. Judkins is day-to-day and Raheim Sanders (hip) is reportedly headed for IR, so the Browns are thin at running back.

players.name: Jaylen Warren
players.note: Mike McCarthy has called Warren the featured back, dropping the earlier 'one-two punch' plan with Dowdle. In the Week 5 win over the Colts, Warren had 15 carries for 101 yards and a TD, plus 6 catches for 87 yards and a TD (reported Oct 12-13).

players.name: Rico Dowdle
players.note: OC Brian Angelichio said Monday (Oct 12) that he expects Dowdle (dislocated toe, missed 3 games) back in Week 6 against Tampa Bay. With Warren now named the featured back, Dowdle will likely play limited snaps as a backup.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Kamara played a season-low 12 snaps in the Week 5 loss to Minnesota after a back issue limited his practices, and Kendre Miller scored the Saints' only offensive TD.

players.name: Kendre Miller
players.note: With Kamara limited to a season-low 12 snaps by a back issue in the Week 5 loss to Minnesota, Miller ran 10 times for 30 yards and scored the Saints' only offensive TD. Etienne is still about 2 weeks from being eligible to come off IR.

players.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
players.note: Practiced fully Wednesday (Oct 14) after limited sessions Mon-Tue with the ankle he hurt in Week 5, and has no game status on Seattle's final report, so he is good to go for TNF at Denver tonight. That full session was a light walkthrough on a short week, so he may not be completely over the ankle.

players.name: Deebo Samuel
players.note: Strained his hamstring in the Oct 11 game against Seattle and was ruled out right away. Shanahan said Monday (Oct 12) he will miss 'at least a couple of weeks', and other reports say several weeks.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Returned to practice as a limited participant Wednesday (Oct 14), which opens his 21-day window to come off IR (ankle, hurt in Week 1). He is eligible for Sunday vs. the Jets, but reports disagree on whether he will play this week.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Was designated to return from IR and practiced fully Wednesday (Oct 14), four weeks after wrist surgery. Coach Jesse Minter said he has a chance to play Sunday at Cleveland.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Did not practice Wednesday (Oct 14) with hamstring and toe issues and only worked on the JUGS machine, after missing the last two games. Sirianni is 'hopeful' he plays Sunday vs. Carolina, but he needs to practice first.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Was limited Wednesday (Oct 14) with a hamstring issue but is expected to play Sunday vs. Carolina. If DeVonta Smith misses a third straight game, Wicks stays a top Eagles receiver and is flex-worthy.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Did not practice Wednesday (Oct 14), though that was an estimate because Buffalo only held a walkthrough. He missed Week 5 with the shoulder injury and needs at least a limited practice before he can be trusted for Week 6.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Coach Aaron Glenn revealed on Oct 14 that Mitchell had a procedure on his injured finger, and he is now week-to-week. He did not practice Wednesday and looks unlikely to play this week.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Missed Week 5 with a hamstring injury. Reports during Minnesota's Week 6 bye (around Oct 12-14) say he is expected back for Week 7.

players.name: Marvin Harrison
players.note: The Cardinals traded Harrison to the Texans (made official Oct 12, pending a physical), reuniting him with C.J. Stroud. He had only 5 catches in 4 games in Arizona, and his Week 6 debut in London is uncertain because of the quick turnaround.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: With Harrison traded to Houston (Oct 11-12), Wilson is clearly Arizona's top WR. He leads the team with 258 receiving yards and recently signed an extension through 2029.

players.name: Kendrick Bourne
players.note: Harrison's trade to HOU (Oct 12) moves Bourne up to Arizona's No. 2 WR behind Wilson. With Harrison inactive in Week 5 he led the Cardinals with 70 yards on 8 targets.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.note: Houston added Marvin Harrison Jr. by trade (Oct 11-12), so there is more competition for targets alongside Collins. Collins should stay the WR1, but his target share ceiling shrinks a little.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: Dell is still on IR, with his practice window open since Oct 7, and the Texans traded for Marvin Harrison Jr. on Oct 11-12. That pushes Dell further down the pecking order once he is activated.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: Rice (hamstring, hurt Oct 4) did not practice Wednesday, Oct 14, even after the Chiefs' bye week. His Week 6 game vs. the Chargers is in doubt.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: Tyquan Thornton went to IR (reported Oct 12, possibly out 12-16 weeks) and Rashee Rice missed Wednesday's practice (Oct 14). That leaves Worthy as KC's clear top WR for now.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: On Oct 13 Harbaugh called Harris's hamstring 'week to week'. With the Chargers' Week 7 bye, his realistic return is Week 8.

players.name: Quentin Johnston
players.note: Johnston (chest) was limited in practice Wednesday, Oct 14, after missing Week 5. That puts him on track to possibly return in Week 6 vs. KC.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey (foot) was active in Week 5 but played zero offensive snaps. On Oct 12 Harbaugh said he will keep working in practice, and he may need a full session to avoid another questionable tag.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson dislocated or injured a finger in Week 5. On Oct 13 McCarthy ruled him out for Week 6 at Tampa Bay, and reports say he will miss multiple weeks.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: On Oct 12 Shanahan said Deebo Samuel (hamstring) will 'miss some time', likely through the Week 8 bye. Evans (7-113-1 in Week 5) is SF's clear top WR, with Cooks next up.

players.name: KC Concepcion
players.note: The rookie suffered a concussion from a helmet-to-helmet hit vs. the Jets on Oct 11 and is in the protocol. His Week 6 availability is doubtful.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: The Patriots opened A.J. Brown's 21-day IR practice window on Oct 14, and Brown was limited. His return would cut into Doubs' targets soon.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: DeVonta Smith (hamstring/toe) did not practice Wednesday, Oct 14. If Smith misses time, rookie Lemon would likely take a larger Week 6 role.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: On Oct 14 agent Drew Rosenhaus said Hill is 'close' to 100% from his knee injury and is being shopped to contenders. He also remains under an NFL personal conduct review and could face discipline (reported Oct 14).
